title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. We r a no. of persons living in a village having 2 mosques there. We left our own mosque some years before & migrated to another near one in our village because the Imam of our own mosque committs shirak. But now for Dawa purpose and for spreading pure Islam irrespective of any sects in that Mosque we made a n entry again few days ago. But that Imam is still there and we offer Salah behind him. As we are there only to spread real Islam and our presence and offering Salah in that Mosque seems important to us. But a few of the youth of ours repeat the Salah individually and some do not agree to offer Salah behind that Imam but it is felt that our presence is important there so that we can spread teachings of Quran and Sahi Hadith and Pure Tawheed. Now please reply to us in the context of Quran, Sahi Hadith and ijma that:- 1. Can we offer Salah behind that Imam in these conditions? Or 2. Shall we need to repeat the Salah? Or 3. Shall we not offer Salah behind that Imam? Or 4. Is there any other alternative for this so that we can try to Spread Pure Islam there and offer salah and also to remove Concepts & Roots of SHIRAK from there? Kindly reply at earliest. 1859 views Q. 1. When offering namaz behind an imam in jamat should any one recite the following in his heart a. Sana before the imam begins reciting surah Fatiha b. In ruku ? Subhan Rabbial-al azim c. In sajda ? Subhan Rabbial Alla d. If the namaz is of 4 rakats, then in the 3rd and 4th rakats surah fatiha e. In sitting position the recitation of At-Tashahud after the first two rakats and in the fourth rakat 2. What is the procedure for performing Forgetfulness Prostrations (Sujuud Sahw) 3. Is it mandatory to recite "RABBI IGHFIR LEE" in the sitting pause between the two prostration of every unit of the prayer. 7783 views Q. During the masjid jamaat if small children (not offering namaz) come in front of imam is the namaz valid. 2.during the masjid jamaat if small children ( are offering namaz) come in front of imam is the namaz valid. 3. same above questions but not in masjid but in house. 2371 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 369 Country: India Title: I follow hanafi Maslak. Now my question is that if i am in Safr can i pray Zohr & Asr together or Magrib & Issa together? Question: I follow hanafi Maslak. Now my question is that if i am in Safr can i pray Zohr & Asr together or Magrib & Issa together? Please advice from Quran and Hadith Answer ID: 369 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 174=170/L) According to Hanafi Maslak it is not allowed to combine prayers (in real meaning): ولاجمع بین فرضین في وقت بعذر سفر أ و مطر (الدرالمختار مع الشامي، 2/45 ، ط زکریا دیوبند) Instead, one can combine in a way that, for example, one prays Zuhr at the end of Zuhr time and prays Asr at the beginning of its time. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
